description: Some concrete candidate exists at w: an occurring thought has a bearer, who exercises intellect in it and therefore causes something at w (OPEN and contested: the inner word); whatever causes at w is concrete (OPEN activity clause of the causal criterion); and the bearer exists at w. Concreteness is derived from a performed act through a typed criterion, not assumed of bearers (no STMT-COGITO-BEARER-IS-CONCRETE).
